plan: NO POSITION. Rejecting despite a nominally positive +16% e_fv - the distribution is not underwritable at this depth, and a positive e_fv resting on an unverified cash claim is exactly the shape a discount-that-never-closes produces. Also blocked mechanically: the only dated catalyst is the 2026-08-18 print, 15 days out, inside the contract's ~2-week no-blind-entry window. Sizing reality: a 0.4% position is ~$13k against a multi-hour 20-F/HKEX primary-source job to close the gaps - the coverage economics do not clear.
catalyst: 2026-08-18 print (the only dated event). No other named catalyst exists - which is precisely why the FALLING gate's catalyst requirement bites here.
kill_triggers: re-court ONLY on a verified return-of-capital event: an executed buyback in the 20-F or an HKEX filing cutting share count >5%, OR a declared recurring dividend
edge_explainer: The cheapest thing in the batch on paper and still not a candidate. Market cap ~$1.05B, cash $951M, debt $10M -> ENTERPRISE VALUE ~$110M against ~$350M revenue, 47.8% gross margin, 19.1% net margin, +8.3% revenue growth. ADR CHECK (contract-mandated): trailingPE 17.3 x EPS 0.10 = $1.73 = the live price, so the per-ADS earnings basis reconciles and there is no TCOM-style unit artifact - CONFIRMED. But marketCap $1,060.7M / sharesOutstanding 542.9M = $1.95 != $1.73, because the share count is Class-A-only while the cap is A+B; true count ~610M. Data trap logged. Dual-primary on HKEX (2391.HK) materially mitigates the ADR-delisting tail, which the 'China ADR' label obscures. WHY REJECT ANYWAY: (1) frame mismatch both directions - the entire margin of safety is balance-sheet cash, i.e. book value, which the tier-1/2 frame declares irrelevant; and the $4.06 Feb-2025 'own high' was a speculative spike, so '-57% from its own high' measures off a number that never represented the business. (2) NO VERIFIED MECHANISM CLOSES THE DISCOUNT - cash location (onshore RMB vs offshore), the VIE's claim on it, buyback execution against the Jan-2026 10% authorisation, and dividend policy are all unverified. UNVERIFIABLE != clean, and here the unverified item IS the thesis. (3) Cause-check finds no event at all: no single-day move above +/-9% in twelve months, and the -27% three-month grind has no located company cause - a drawdown whose cause appears genuinely absent rather than merely unread is its own kind of unknown. It is, however, the one name in the cohort where 'falling' is literal: +7% off a low set 11 days ago, the freshest in the batch. No XBRL - foreign private issuer, all fundamentals yfinance-derived rather than audited-primary.
